Thank you all for those critical flags. We have three serious conflicts with the draft production plan that need to be resolved before I can sign off:

1. Riley — the option agreement authorizes 8 episodes, not 10, and requires the title credit 'Based on the novel by Celia Voss.' We'll need to revise the episode count and ensure that credit language is included.

2. Samir — the platform requires stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility, and will reject binaural. The plan's binaural specification has to be replaced.

3. Jo — the principals can only record together on August 12–14, and their agreement requires joint sessions. The plan's separate remote sessions won't work.

All three of you have also noted that your documentation hasn't yet made it into the production records or greenlight packet. Before I give binding approval, I need each of you to confirm that your fact-tagged reports are being filed into the production records as part of this greenlight meeting, per studio requirement. Once I have that confirmation, I'll issue the settlement revising the production package accordingly. Can each of you confirm your reports are being recorded and filed now?
